data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to communicate with USB devices on the web using the WebUSB API.
data.what_it_does: Provides access to USB devices from Flutter Web using the official WebUSB API. Allows pairing devices with filters, sending and receiving data, and managing device configurations and sessions.
use_when: You need to interact with USB devices directly from a Flutter Web application
You need to send and receive data via USB transfer methods on supported web browsers
avoid_when: You need to target Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, or Linux (this plugin currently only supports the web platform)
You need a cross-platform solution for desktop and mobile USB communication
strengths: Integrates directly with the official WebUSB API
Supports device pairing, filtering, control transfers, and isochronous transfers
weaknesses: Platform support is limited to Web only
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to your pubspec.yaml and import the package. Ensure the browser supports WebUSB.
